PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that a Meeting of the Incline Village General Improvement District (IVGID) Board of Trustees will be
held starting at 4:00 PM on October 14, 2026, in the Boardroom, 893 Southwood Boulevard, Incline Village, Nevada.

Public Comment
Public Comments are welcomed during Public Comment Periods and are limited to 3 minutes per person per Public Comment Period.
Unused time may not be allocated to other speakers. A speaker’s viewpoint will not be restricted; however, reasonable restrictions
may be imposed upon the time, place, and manner of speech. Irrelevant statements, unduly repetitious statements, and personal
attacks that would objectively antagonize or incite others are examples of speech that may be reasonably limited. Not to include
comments on General Business items with scheduled public comments. The Board of Trustees may address matters brought up during
public comments at the conclusion of the comment period but may not deliberate on any non-agendized item.

Members of the public are welcome to provide public comments by telephone at (877) 853-5247 and in the Civic Plus Portal at:
https://www.yourtahoeplace.com/about-ivgid/ivgid-board-of-trustees/meeting-agendas-materials-minutes/ .
The Webinar ID will be posted to the District Website on the Day of the meeting, and will be available
at: https://www.yourtahoeplace.com/about-ivgid/ivgid-board-of-trustees/board-committee-meetings/.
The meeting will be available for viewing at: https://ivgid.portal.civicclerk.com/.



A.        PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE*

B.        ROLL CALL OF TRUSTEES*

C.        ROLL CALL OF TRUSTEE CANDIDATES* (Ryan Brooks, David Noble, and Harry Swenson)
D.        INITIAL PUBLIC COMMENTS Public comment is welcomed during Public Comment Periods and is Limited to 3 minutes per person per
          Public Comment Period. Unused time may not be allocated to other speakers. A speaker’s viewpoint will not be restricted; however, reasonable restrictions
          may be imposed upon the time, place, and manner of speech. Irrelevant statements, unduly repetitious statements, and personal attacks that would objectively
          antagonize or incite others are examples of speech that may be reasonably limited. Not to include comments on General Business items with scheduled
          public comments. The Board of Trustees may address matters brought up during public comments at the conclusion of the comment period but may not
          deliberate on any non-agendized item. Members of the Public are welcome to provide Public Comment by Telephone at (877) 853-5247 and in the Civic
          Plus Portal at https://ivgid.portal.civicclerk.com/ (the Webinar ID will be Posted to the District Website on the Day of the Meeting). The Meeting will be
          Available for viewing at https://www.yourtahoeplace.com/about-ivgid/ivgid-board-of-trustees/meeting-agendas-materials-minutes/.

E.        APPROVAL OF AGENDA (For possible Action)
          The Board of Trustees may make a motion for a flexible agenda which is defined as taking items on the agenda out of order; combining agenda items with
          other agenda items; removing items from the agenda; moving agenda items to an agenda of another meeting or voting on items in a block.
          -OR- The Board of Trustees may make a motion to accept and follow the agenda as submitted/posted.

F.        BOARD OF TRUSTEES UPDATE - (Not for possible Action) Updates are intended to inform the Board and/or
          the public. The Board of Trustees will not deliberate or take action with respect to any of the reported items.

G.        GENERAL BUSINESS - (For possible Action)

             1.       SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Review and Approve Business Impact Statements Related to
                      Ordinance No. 2 Rates, Rules, and Regulations for Sewer Service and Ordinance No. 4 Rates, Rules, and
                      Regulations for Water Service by the Incline Village General Improvement District in Compliance with
                      Nevada Revised Statute (NRS) 237.080. (Requesting Staff Member: Director of Public Works Kate
                      Nelson)

             2.        SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) PUBLIC HEARING - Time: 4:00 PM and as soon thereafter as

                       Public Hearing for the Proposed Amendments to Ordinance No. 2 - Sewer Ordinance Establishing
                       Rates, Rules, and Regulations for Sewer Service by the Incline Village General Improvement
                       District.

                       Public Comments will be taken separately on this item. The Board Chair will set the time limit for these

                         the Amendments to Ordinance No. 2, an Ordinance Establishing Rates, Rules, and Regulations for
                         Sewer Service by Incline Village General Improvement District. No Adjustments to Current Rates are
                         Being Considered. (Requesting Staff Member: Director of Public Works Kate Nelson).

                         Recommendation for Action: That the Board of Trustees make a Motion to Adopt Resolution No. 1930
                         Formally Approving Amendments to Ordinance No. 2, an Ordinance Establishing Rates, Rules, and
                         Regulations for Sewer Service by Incline Village General Improvement District.

             3.        SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) PUBLIC HEARING - Time: 4:00 PM and as soon thereafter as

                       Public Hearing for the Proposed Amendments to Ordinance No. 4 - Water Ordinance Establishing
                       Rates, Rules, and Regulations for Water Service by the Incline Village General Improvement
                       District.

                       Public Comments will be taken separately on this item. The Board Chair will set the time limit for these
                       comments at the meeting. It is anticipated that the time limit will be set at 3 minutes.

                  A.     SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Adopt Resolution No. 1931 Formally Approving the Amendments
                         to Ordinance No. 4 - Establishing Rates, Rules, and Regulations for Water Service by the Incline
                         Village General Improvement District. No Adjustments to Current Rates are Being Considered.
                         (Requesting Staff Member: Director of Public Works Kate Nelson).

                         Recommendation for Action: That the Board of Trustees make a Motion to Adopt Resolution No. 1931

                         Regulations for Water Service by Incline Village General Improvement District.

             4.        SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Budget Transfer for payroll costs related to Parks employees from
                       Internal Service Funds to Community Service Funds (Requesting Staff Member: Director of Finance
                       Noemi Barter)

             5.       SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Review, Discuss, and Possibly Approve a Professional Service
                      Agreement between Incline Village General Improvement District and Bullpen Innovation Consulting to

                      Recommendation for Action: That the Board of Trustees makes a Motion to Approve a Professional

H.        REPORTS TO THE BOARD - (Not for possible Action) Reports are intended to inform the Board and/or the
          public. The Board of Trustees will not deliberate or take action with respect to any of the reported items.

             1.       SUBJECT: (Not for possible Action) - District General Manager's Monthly Status Report. (Requesting
                      Staff Member: District General Manager Robert Harrison)

             2.       SUBJECT: (Not for possible Action) Financial Reports Covering August 2026 Results; to include the
                      Board Treasurer's Report, Monthly Bill Pay Report and Monthly District Financial Report. (Requesting
                      Staff Member: Director of Finance Noemi Barter)
I.        CONSENT CALENDAR - (For possible Action)
             1.       SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Approval of the IVGID Board of Trustees Meeting Minutes for
                      September 9, 2026. (Requesting Staff Member: District Clerk Heidi White)
             2.       SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Approval of the IVGID Board of Trustees Meeting Minutes for
                      September 23, 2026. (Requesting Staff Member: District Clerk Heidi White)
             3.       SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Award a Four-Year Bulk Fuel Purchase and Delivery Agreement to
                      Hunt Oil of California, in an Amount Not to Exceed $190,000 per Year, Pursuant to NRS 332.065 and
                      Board Policy 21.1.0, and Authorize the Closure of the FY27 Blanket Purchase Order for Bulk Fuel with
                      Flyers Energy, LLC. (Requesting Staff Member: Director of Finance Noemi Barter)

                      Recommendation for Action: That the Board of Trustees makes a motion to award a four-year bulk fuel
                      purchase and delivery agreement to Hunt Oil of California, in an amount not to exceed $190,000 per
                      year, pursuant to NRS 332.065 and Board Policy 21.1.0, and authorize the closure of the FY 27 blanket
                      purchase order for bulk fuel with Flyers Energy, LLC

             4.       SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Approve the Jacks Valley Ranch Effluent Revenue Agreement for an
                      Annual Amount of $7,000 with Annual CPI Adjustment for a Term of 30 Years. (Requesting Staff
                      Member: Director of Public Works Kate Nelson)

J.          LONG RANGE CALENDAR - (For possible Action)

               1.        SUBJECT: (For Possible Action) Review, Discuss and possibly Add or Remove Long-Range Calendar

K.          FINAL PUBLIC COMMENTS - Limited to a maximum of three minutes in duration.

L.          ADJOURNMENT - (For possible Action)

CERTIFICATION OF POSTING OF THIS AGENDA
I hereby certify that on or before 9:00 AM on Friday, October 9, 2026, a copy of this agenda (IVGID Board of Trustees Session of October 14, 2026) was delivered to
the post office addressed to the people who have requested to receive copies of IVGID’s agendas; copies were e-mailed to those people who have requested; and a copy
was posted, physically or electronically, at the following locations in accordance with Assembly Bill 213:

       1. IVGID Anne Vorderbruggen Building (893 Southwood Boulevard, Incline Village, Nevada; Administrative Offices)
       2. IVGID’s website (www.yourtahoeplace.com/ivgid/board-of-trustees/meetings-and-agendas)
       3. IVGID's CivicPlus Portal (https://ivgid.portal.civicclerk.com/)
       4. State of Nevada Public Noticing website (https://notice.nv.gov/)
       5. IVGID's Recreation Center (980 Incline Way, Incline Village, Nevada)


Individuals may request copies of all agenda materials by contacting the District Clerk or by visiting the Administrative Offices at the address listed above.
